sentences.text: Shri Aayush Pandey - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Surendra Kumar Gupta - Ga for the respondent/State

Heard on I.A.No.10563/2025, which is the third application filed under Section 430 of BNSS, 2023 for execution of suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the appellant - Ashok Thakur.

2. Learned Trial Court has convicted the appellant under Sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n) of the IPC r/w section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and sentenced him to 1 year R.I. with fine of Rs.1,000/-,
3 years R.I. with fine of Rs.2,000/-, 20 years R.I. with fine of Rs.5,000/- and 20 years R.I. with fine of Rs.5,000/- respectively with default stipulations, vide its judgement of conviction and order of sentence dated 19.10.2023 passed by the Special Judge, POCSO Act, 2012, Depalpur, District - Indore (M.P.) in S.C. No.17/2022.
This Court has already considered the first application for suspension of sentence on merit on 12.04.2024.

3. Prosecution case in brief are that the appellant/accused committed the offence towards the victim/child aged of 12 years, 9 months and 12 days by kidnapping her and committing aggravated penetrative sexual assault during the period of 18.06.2021 to 18.08.2021.

4. The aforesaid I.A. has been filed on the ground that the trial Court has committed error in convicting the appellant, there is material 2 CRA-14578-2023 contradiction and inconsistency in the testimony of prosecution witnesses and the finding of the trial Court is based on conjecture and surmises.
The trial Court committed error in considering the material omissions and contradictions in the statement of prosecution witnesses.
The appellant is permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh and there is no apprehension of his running from justice during the pendency of the appeal.
Hence it is prayed that application for suspension of jail sentence be allowed.
5. Learned Govt. Advocate for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer.

sentences.text: 6. Considering the statements of victim (PW-1), her father (PW-2), her mother (PW-3), Medical Officer, Rekha Chouhan (PW-5) and Section 29 of the POCSO Act, 2015, the case for suspension of execution of sentence and grant of bail is not made out at present.
7. Accordingly, I.A.No.10563/2025 stands rejected (VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) (ALOK AWASTHI)
